## Objective
- Add named crew members with individual health to the existing Last Light survival game.
- Make random events injure or heal crew, and lose the run if all three die.

## Requirements
- Show three crew names below the stat bars.
- Event cards should update a crew member’s status.
- Build directly without asking clarifying questions; verify the result, including a small JPEG screenshot.

## Decisions
- Added Mara Venn, Eli Torres, and Jun Park as the crew.
- Crew health effects are randomly applied when an event appears, then reflected after the player chooses an option.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a responsive crew roster with individual health bars and FIT/WOUNDED/CRITICAL/DOWN statuses.
- Added occasional named crew injury/healing updates to event cards.
- Added a loss condition when all three crew members are dead.

- Add Scrap and neon market stops every 25 miles for trading Fuel, Rations, and crew-healing Medkits.
- Add a bottom-of-screen Scavenge button that pauses travel for a 10-second tap-to-shoot drone mini-game rewarding Food, Fuel, and Scrap.

## Requirements
- Market stops pause the van; leaving resumes the run.
- Fuel and Rations cost 8 Scrap for 20 units; a Medkit costs 12 Scrap and heals the most injured living crew member by 35 vitals.
- Scrap accrues at 1.2 per mile.
- Scavenge verification: tap the button, shoot a drone, and confirm resources increase after returning to the road.

## Decisions
- Crew vitals and injury mechanics were retained to make Medkit healing meaningful.
- Scavenge rewards are designed as +2 Fuel, +2 Rations, and +2 Scrap per drone hit.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added market UI, Scrap HUD and accrual, trading, pause/resume behavior, and crew healing in `index.html`.
- Browser-tested a temporary copy of the market: it opened at 25.2 miles; Fuel, Rations, and Medkit trades worked; leaving resumed travel.
- Added Scavenge button, mini-game UI, drone targets, countdown, hit tracking, and loot display in `index.html`.

### Active
- Finish Scavenge behavior: the attempted insertion of its JavaScript handlers failed because the exact target text did not match; timer completion, hit rewards, returning to road, and pause integration are not yet wired.
- Verify Scavenge interaction and resource increases; rerun syntax validation and `git diff --check`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Read the current `index.html` script around `showEvent`, `tick`, and event handlers; insert Scavenge logic using exact current context.
2. Ensure `tick` updates the mini-game timer while travel remains paused, and ensure the Scavenge launch button is disabled during other pauses.
3. Test shooting drones, the 10-second completion, return-to-road loot gains, then run JavaScript syntax validation and `git diff --check`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Contains the game, market and crew mechanics, and partially added Scavenge interface/styles.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; earlier status showed only `M index.html`.
- Earlier validation passed before the Scavenge additions; Scavenge code was not yet validated.
- An insertion failed with “Could not find oldString in index.html. It must match exactly, including whitespace and indentation.” No Scavenge JavaScript behavior was inserted by that failed call.

## Objective
- Add Scrap-based neon market stops every 25 miles and a 10-second drone-shooting Scavenge mini-game to the survival game in `index.html`.

## Requirements
- Market stops pause travel; leaving resumes the run.
- Fuel and Rations cost 8 Scrap for 20 units; a Medkit costs 12 Scrap and heals the most injured living crew member by 35 vitals.
- Scrap accrues at 1.2 per mile.
- Scavenge pauses travel; drone hits reward Food, Fuel, and Scrap. Verify resources increase after returning to the road.

## Decisions
- Retain crew vitals and injury mechanics so Medkit healing has a purpose.
- Each drone hit rewards +2 Fuel, +2 Rations, and +2 Scrap.

- Added market UI, Scrap HUD and accrual, trading, pause/resume behavior, and crew healing.
- Added Scavenge button and mini-game UI, tap-to-shoot drones, 10-second timer, hit tracking, loot display, and return-to-road rewards.
- JavaScript syntax validation passed; `git diff --check` passed.
- Browser-tested a temporary market copy: market opened at 25.2 miles, trades worked, and leaving resumed travel.

### Active

- (none)

- `index.html`: Contains the game, market features, and Scavenge implementation.

- Scavenge browser verification is still pending.
